verdict.rationale: The pack documents no user-defined rule engine in Statsig that fires actions automatically when events occur. Nearby features do not count: Scheduled Rollouts run on a time schedule, Autotune is a fixed traffic-allocation algorithm, Infra Analytics alerts only notify, targeting rules decide who sees a flag, and CLI-in-CI/CD automation is a user-built workaround.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
